src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/input/InputBindingsRow.tsx:53 One button per row in a 16-row native table is the right shape (few rows, not a grid). pairs.registryProposal: grid-keyboard-model frames the choice as native table vs grid. It could say outright that a third shape, read-only tabular data drawn as styled divs with no table or grid roles, is the failure, because it loses header association for assistive technology.
